name: PHP2Shell
summary: Pre-authentication remote code execution in the PHP interpreter (any SAPI that serves web requests).

detection.notes: Plugin 369483 and the first distro checks were published on 2026-10-21. Distro and unpatched checks kept arriving through 2026-10-23, so a feed from 2026-10-21 to 2026-10-23 may lack some of them.

versions.no_official_fix: 7.4 to 8.1 have only minimal source backports from the PHP security team; 7.3 and older are end-of-life.

mitigations: Update PHP to 8.2.35, 8.3.36, 8.4.27 or 8.5.12, or apply your distribution's patched package. Updating is the only complete fix.

Until then: set memory_limit=-1 in a way applications can't override, and session.upload_progress.enabled=0. On PHP 8.5, also set fatal_error_backtraces=0. Restart every PHP worker after the change. These reduce exposure but don't make an installation safe.
PHP 8.1 and older have no official release: upgrade, or isolate or take the system offline.
